name: mastra-1.32
description: The closest published set to the older Mastra the host runs: @mastra/core 1.32.1 (there is no 1.32.9 on the registry). Package version counters are independent; these are matched by release date. The CLI would pull the newest deployer and server, so those are pinned through overrides. @mastra/memory (1.17.5 in this set) is no longer a dependency, so it is not installed.
